summary: Tested portrait image fix in intro.tsx, kitchen.tsx, and garden.tsx. All character portrait circles now display actual character images instead of blank dark circles. The RNAnimated.Image fix works correctly on web.

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' - Expected on web, non-critical, cross-fade still works correctly.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Portrait fix fully verified. All 3 screens (intro, kitchen, garden) show actual character images in circular portrait areas. No blank dark circles. Cross-fade between portrait variants (rupertlaugh → rupert) works correctly in intro dialog.
rca_of_issue: Root cause was Reanimated Animated.View + absoluteFill + overflow:hidden causing image clip to 0x0 on web. Fix: replaced with RNAnimated.Image (React Native built-in) with opacity prop directly on the Image component. Fix is confirmed working.
